thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging #incidents — elevated error rate and routing fallback oscillation detected for account-redwood-prod around 03:12 UTC. Trigger: routing-policy-eval mismatch. Paging primary oncall Priya.

Priya (oncall): looking now, thanks. can someone dump the policy diff?

Marco: I pushed the schema change earlier today in config-service: replaced `fallback_model` with `fallback_variants` and set a default list. I did quick unit checks but didn't run the runtime compatibility check. cc @Priya

Priya (oncall): ok that's probably it. I'm seeing repeated failover between region-us-east-1 and region-eu-west-1 for model family 'redwood-lite' — requests are flipping variants and hitting cold starts. error rate spiking ~22% for generation requests in host-api-prod cluster-3.

OpsBot: Metrics snapshot — 03:10-03:14 UTC: 5xx rate +21.8%, P95 latency increased 2.3x, failed model load retries up 47%. Top error: ModelVariantResolutionError: no compatible variant found -> fallback invoked.

Jamie: any electable fallback configured? Marco, what did the default list look like?

Marco: the new schema set `fallback_variants: ["auto-mix", "best-effort"]` as default. Previously we had an explicit `fallback_model: "redwood-small"` default in runtime config. Looks like runtime still expects the old field in some places. So when it reads the new list, it tries variant negotiation and ends up cycling.

Priya (oncall): that matches the logs. runtime logs show: `WARN route=smart-routing: deprecated field fallback_model missing; attempting variant negotiation; no pinned fallback; trigger cascade`. then `ERROR route=smart-routing: fallback resolution loop detected, incrementing fallback count`.

Li: quick mitigation proposal: 1) disable smart-routing -> fallback to static routing for affected prefixes, 2) set explicit runtime env `FORCE_FALLBACK_MODEL=redwood-small` on host-api-prod, 3) roll back config-service change. Which should we do first?

Priya (oncall): Do 1 and 2 now. Rolling config-service back needs approvals and could take longer. We need to stop customer impact.

Khaled: I'm on it, toggling smart-routing off for the impacted routing group (customer-prefix: acct-*) via console.

Khaled: done. smart-routing toggled off at 03:18 UTC.

OpsBot: Task update — feature-flag smart-routing for acct-* set to OFF.

Priya (oncall): I'm applying `FORCE_FALLBACK_MODEL=redwood-small` to the host-api-prod env on cluster-3 now.

Priya (oncall): patched env and restarted router processes at 03:20 UTC.

OpsBot: Health check: 03:21 UTC — 5xx rate down 40% vs peak, P95 latency trending down.

Jamie: good, early signs look better. Do we have any customers actively reporting incidents?

Customer Success: We're seeing two support tickets for slowness from high-volume accounts — CS has acknowledged and will notify customers that we're investigating and mitigating.

Marco: I'll prep an emergency rollback of the schema change in config-service and a compatibility shim in runtime that honors `fallback_model` when `fallback_variants` exists. That should prevent recurrence.

Priya (oncall): assign rollback to Marco. Marco, estimate?

Marco: If I cut the rollback PR and coordinate a config-service deploy, ~25-40 minutes. The shim in runtime is a small patch, ~15 mins and can be rolled as a canary to cluster-3.

Khaled: handing pager to Marco in 10. Marco, you'll be primary for the next 1h while I monitor other customers.

Marco: taking pager. I'll open a brief postmortem doc and timeline after we stabilize.

Priya (oncall): steps summary:
- immediate: smart-routing OFF for acct-*, set FORCE_FALLBACK_MODEL on cluster-3 (done)
- short: deploy runtime shim honoring fallback_model (Marco)
- medium: rollback config-service schema change and run compatibility tests (Marco)
- notify: CS to contact impacted accounts and ops to monitor metrics for 2h

Khaled: started runtime canary patch rollout to 5% nodes at 03:31 UTC.

OpsBot: Canary health @03:35 UTC — no errors on canary nodes, request success rate normal.

Priya (oncall): cool. Marco, once rollback is live, re-enable smart-routing in a controlled canary and monitor for oscillations.

Marco: rollback PR merged at 03:45 UTC, deploy started. Will keep smart-routing off until we validate.

OpsBot: Deploy status: config-service rollback -> SUCCESS at 03:52 UTC.

Priya (oncall): re-enabling smart-routing for a single non-prod prefix first. then we'll canary prod.

Marco: prod rollback validated against our compatibility test harness. I'm starting a canary for acct-* with smart-routing ON at 03:58 UTC to 10% traffic routed.

OpsBot: Canary metrics 04:02 UTC — stable. No fallback loops, P95 latency back to baseline.

Priya (oncall): okay slowly scale to 50% over next 15m, if stable we'll re-enable for everyone.

Customer Success: Updated customers at 04:10 UTC. No escalations so far.

Khaled: scaling to 50% now.

OpsBot: 04:20 UTC — 5xx rate normalized across clusters, fallback-loop alerts cleared.

Jamie: final checklist before we close the pager: 1) postmortem draft, 2) fix test harness to catch schema/runtime mismatches, 3) add a runtime flag that rejects unknown/deprecated schema changes at deploy time, 4) follow-up with config-service owner to add pre-deploy compatibility gate.

Marco: will do 1+2. I'll also add a compatibility shim and unit tests so future schema changes fail fast.

Priya (oncall): Thanks all. handing back to normal rotations. I'll close the incident channel in 30m after docs are up.

IncidentBot: Incident resolved: service health restored at 04:22 UTC. Pager closed.

Priya (oncall): Postmortem action owners: Marco (rollback + tests), Jamie (deploy gate proposal), Khaled (runbook update), Li (runtime telemetry alert tuning), Customer Success (customer comms follow-up).

Marco: quick note for postmortem: root cause = config schema change introduced new default semantics (`fallback_variants`) while runtime still expected legacy field (`fallback_model`) in some code paths -> caused variant negotiation loops and fallback thrashing. Mitigation = toggle and explicit fallback, rollback, compatibility shim, deploy gates.

Li: will add an alert to detect repeated fallback resolution events ( > 5 loops in 1m ) to trigger earlier paging.

Customer Success: We'll send a short incident summary to affected accounts with mitigation steps and timeline.

Priya (oncall): closing thread in 30. good work team. :tada:
